Blocker bd-01KZXQAW39E8XCXJJVW7C7M2M6 is CLEARED and verified end to end. Measured at p = 50000, q = 4, two runs, r = 6.1mm searchlights, identity metric:

  lm_relation_fit          5.4s
  compile_frame            4.8s     nnz 1557872, mean support 31.2
  plan_geometry            3.8s     packed_width 10, 50000 measurements, dense payload 10.7 MB
  evaluate_geometry       59.3s
  geometry (materialize)  93.0s
  total                  ~166s = 2.8 minutes

Well inside the 30-minute gate, and full materialization succeeds too. IMPORTANT: disregard the ~19-minute figure in my earlier note - that extrapolation was taken on pre-fix code where the dense coercion inflated every stage, so the p^1.8 exponent was an artefact of the defect.

Remaining unknowns for this epic are therefore realistic q and the dense local-metric path, not the plan path. My projected memory table above still stands: geometry() materialization fits 4 GiB to about q = 103 at 50k nodes; query-first is q-independent at 0.38 MB.

Minor: the two upstream stages slowed between runs (1.7 -> 5.4s, 1.2 -> 4.8s). Neither touches the frame signature so this is likely concurrent Epic 7 work rather than the fix, but worth a glance when you take real gate measurements.
